name: open-codex-micro
description: Control Codex Desktop from Ulanzi Studio through a local bridge

scripts.build:all: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:antigravity:bridge && npm run build:antigravity:plugin
scripts.check:node: node --check scripts/install.mjs && node --check scripts/install-plugin.mjs && node --check scripts/install-antigravity-plugin.mjs && node --check scripts/uninstall.mjs && node --check scripts/build-bridge.mjs && node --check scripts/build-antigravity-bridge.mjs && node --check src/bridge/thread-key.mjs && node --check src/bridge/codex-cdp.mjs && node --check src/bridge/server.mjs && node --check src/bridge-antigravity/state-reader.mjs && node --check src/bridge-antigravity/server.mjs
scripts.check:plugin: npm --prefix integration/com.ulanzi.codexmicro.ulanziPlugin run check && npm --prefix integration/com.ulanzi.codexmicro.ulanziPlugin run smoke
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run check:node && npm run build:all && npm run check:plugin
scripts.install:all: npm run install:plugin && npm run install:plugin:antigravity
